data.long_meaning: Rutvik is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'rut', which means a path or a course. The suffix 'vik' denotes a chariot, indicating that Rutvik is someone who guides others on their path to success and enlightenment.

in_hindi.long_meaning:
रूप (Roop) - form, appearance
तत्व (Tattva) - reality, truth
विकास (Vikas) - development, growth

Therefore, Rutvik means 'One who develops or grows in form or appearance, or who is content with the reality or truth of the self or life.'
